svg.title: Chronicle speed ratio heatmap across all comparable workloads
svg.desc: Each cell is node-cron median divided by Chronicle median. Green above one favors Chronicle; red below one favors node-cron.
svg.text: All comparable workloads — median speed ratio
node-cron p50 / Chronicle p50: green >1 favors Chronicle; red <1 favors node-cron.
Green means Chronicle was faster; red means node-cron was faster. See summary.md for methodology.
